title: Gandhi Hospital's IVF unit records 3 deliveries in a week

What happened
slides.body: A government hospital's IVF unit recorded three successful deliveries in a week.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Private fertility centres in Hyderabad are under scrutiny in an illegal egg trade case.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: The first couple had struggled with infertility for 16 years before the Nov 10 birth.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Watch for the state's action on private ART centres in the oocyte case. Ask: How many couples can the government IVF unit take each year?

captions.instagram:
Gandhi Hospital's IVF unit records 3 deliveries in a week

The IVF unit at Gandhi Hospital, Secunderabad, recorded three deliveries between Nov 10 and 18: two boys and a girl. The couples came from Warangal, Vikarabad and Yadadri Bhuvanagiri districts.

Why it matters: Private fertility centres in Hyderabad are under scrutiny in an illegal egg trade case.

Source: The Hindu. Image: The Hindu
